title: Dependency upgrade
description: Upgrades the project's dependencies one at a time, with the tests after each: PyPI, npm and GitHub open.

de.title: Abhängigkeiten aktualisieren
de.description: Aktualisiert die Abhängigkeiten des Projekts eine nach der anderen, mit den Tests nach jeder: PyPI, npm und GitHub offen.

prompt: Upgrade this project's dependencies, one at a time: read its changelog for breaking changes, upgrade it, run the tests, fix what breaks or go back to the old version and say why. A major version only when the tests pass. Keep a log in UPGRADES.md (from, to, what changed, what you fixed) and commit each upgrade on its own.
notes: The lock files change with each upgrade: review the commits before you push.
Other registries (crates.io, Maven Central, NuGet) as in the presets rust, jvm and dotnet: --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
